title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 33
paragraphs: For they laid waste everything, proceeding this way along the river Kephisos, and they burned the city of Drymos, and also the following: Charadra, Erochos, Tethronion, Amphikaia, Neon, Pedieis, Triteis, Elateia, Hyampolis, Parapotamioi, and Abai — where there stood a temple of Apollo, wealthy and furnished with treasuries and votive offerings in abundance, and where there was then, as there is even now, the seat of an oracle. This temple they plundered and burned. Some of the Phokians they also pursued and captured in the mountains, and some women they put to death through repeated outrage.
